{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# GENERATED FROM THIS CHAPTER'S OWN _fork.yml (rule 35 keeps this block here).
#
# The PARENT only. `changes:` used to print here too, and on a chapter whose
# whole point is one decision it was the third copy of that decision on the
# page -- 03 said "the quarter chord is unswept" in the fork list, in its
# prose, and in its specifications, under a title and an arrow that said it
# twice more. `changes:` stays in `_fork.yml`, which is where rule 31 reads it
# and where a `diff` against the parent is reviewed. What CHANGED, for a
# reader, is the arrow on the front page and the specification below.
import pathlib
import re
_fk = pathlib.Path("chapters/01-foam-glider/_fork.yml")
if _fk.exists():
    _p = re.search(r"^parent:\s*(.+?)\s*$", _fk.read_text(), re.M)
    if _p:
        _par = pathlib.Path("chapters") / _p.group(1) / "index.qmd"
        _pt = re.search(r'^title:\s*"(.+)"\s*$', _par.read_text(), re.M) \
            if _par.exists() else None
        print(f"Forked from "
              f"[{_pt.group(1) if _pt else _p.group(1)}](../{_p.group(1)}/).\n")
```
